hooks.command: in=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null) || cmd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("command") or "")' 2>/dev/null) || cmd=$in; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])wp([[:space:]]|$)|wp-cli|wp @'; then printf '[%s] WP-CLI tool executed\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/wp-cli-audit.log" 2>/dev/null; fi
